props.html:
Palm Beach painters

Twenty years of coats that last on the peninsula

Twenty-plus years painting across Sydney has taught us one thing about the far end of the Northern Beaches: the weather writes the brief. Palm Beach sits on a thin strip of land with the Pacific on one side and Pittwater on the other. Salt rides in on the wind. UV is relentless. Shaded southern walls hold moisture long after the rain stops.

So we paint for that. Not with a quick roll and a smile, but with the wash-down, the repairs, the primer and the coating system that actually suits an exposed coastal home. Prep is where a coastal finish is won or lost, and it's the part you can't see once we're done.

We're a licensed team, not a franchise handing your job to whoever was free. You get people who've painted grand headland houses, tucked-away heritage cottages, multi-level headland builds with tricky access, and the family homes in between. Same care, every job. We turn up, we protect your place, and we leave it clean.

Palm Beach is a second-home market for a lot of owners, which means a good chunk of the work is repaint scheduling for a house that sits empty part of the year. We can plan around that, coordinate access, and keep you posted with photos if you're not local. Straightforward, honest, done properly.

Palm Beach painting the volume crews skip

Three jobs the peninsula throws up that a generic house-painting page never mentions. This is the work Palm Beach actually needs.

Coastal exterior systems

Salt-laden air, strong UV, wind-driven rain and year-round marine moisture chew through a cheap exterior job fast. We spec flexible, corrosion-resistant coating systems with mould control and thorough surface prep, protecting timber, render, masonry and metal so the coat holds for years, not a couple of summers.

02

High-end & holiday homes

Architect-designed beach houses and luxury holiday homes need refined interior finishes, careful timber detailing and coastal colour schemes that read right in the light out here. For second homes that sit empty part of the year, we plan maintenance repaints around your access and keep exteriors ahead of the salt.

Steep, high-set & heritage

Palm Beach runs up the headland. That means high facades, exposed balconies, extensive glazing and homes with genuinely awkward access. It also holds local heritage cottages with controls on alterations, materials and colour. We work safely at height and paint with heritage colour approvals in mind.

props.label: Faq
props.html:
Straight answers

Palm Beach painting questions

The things Palm Beach homeowners actually ask before they book. Short answers, no runaround.

What paint and coatings do you use?
We work with premium coastal-grade coating systems chosen for salt air, UV and moisture. We can match a specified brand or a heritage colour range on request, working with recognised trade brands like Dulux, Taubmans and Wattyl, and we spec the system to your job.
How do you prep a coastal exterior?
Wash down to strip salt and grime, scrape and sand back failed coating, repair and fill, treat any rust or rot, then prime. Prep is most of the job. Skip it near the water and the coat lets go early.
Do you offer a workmanship guarantee?
We stand behind our work. We put the exact workmanship guarantee terms in writing on your quote, including the length and what it covers, so it's clear before we start. Ask us to spell it out on the quote.
How often should a Palm Beach home be repainted?
Exposed coastal exteriors usually want attention sooner than inland homes because salt and UV work harder. Sheltered surfaces last longer. We'll tell you honestly what needs doing now and what can wait.
Can you paint a heritage cottage?
Yes. We paint with local heritage controls in mind, including limits on colours and materials for older Palm Beach cottages. Where a heritage impact statement or council approval applies, we work to the approved scheme.
Do you handle holiday homes and empty houses?
Often. We coordinate access for second homes that sit empty part of the year, schedule repaints around your calendar, and send progress photos if you're not on the peninsula while we work.
Can you reach high or steep facades?
Yes. High-set homes, exposed balconies and big glazed facades are normal out here. We set up the right access and edge protection to paint high and awkward surfaces safely and cleanly.
How much does painting cost in Palm Beach?
Every job is fixed price with no call-out fee. Cost depends on size, prep, access and whether it's interior, exterior or both. We inspect the property, then quote. No pricing off a photo.
How long will the job take?
It depends on scope and access. We'll give you a realistic timeframe with the quote and stick to it. A full exterior on a steep coastal home takes longer than a couple of interior rooms.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. Painter Decorator Licence 315254C, with public liability and workers compensation cover. Your home and our crew are covered from day one on site to the final clean-up.
Do you paint roofs, pools and floors too?
Yes. Roof restoration and coating, concrete pool painting, and epoxy floor coatings are all in-house. One licensed team for the whole property, not three separate trades to chase.
Can you paint a strata or commercial building?
Yes. We stage strata and commercial jobs to keep disruption low, work around trading hours or residents, and keep the finish consistent across the whole building.
Will you help with colour choice?
We can talk through coastal colour schemes that suit your home's aspect, materials and the light on the peninsula. For heritage homes we keep the palette inside any approved colour range.
What other suburbs do you cover?
Palm Beach plus the whole Northern Beaches: Whale Beach, Avalon Beach, Clareville, Bilgola Beach, Newport, Bayview, Church Point, Scotland Island, Mona Vale, Elanora Heights, Warriewood, Narrabeen, Collaroy, Dee Why, Curl Curl, Freshwater, Queenscliff, Manly, Fairlight, Manly Vale, Balgowlah, Clontarf, Seaforth, Brookvale, Cromer, Narraweena, Wheeler Heights, Beacon Hill, Allambie Heights, Frenchs Forest, Forestville, Killarney Heights, Davidson, Belrose, Terrey Hills, Ingleside, Duffys Forest and Oxford Falls.

data.name: Sydney Paintmasters
data.description: Licensed painters serving Palm Beach 2108 and the northern peninsula. Exterior, interior, heritage, roof, pool, epoxy, strata and commercial painting built for salt air, hard UV and the steep, exposed homes of the peninsula.

mainEntity.name: What paint and coatings do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We work with premium coastal-grade coating systems chosen for salt air, UV and moisture. We can match a specified brand or a heritage colour range on request, working with recognised trade brands like Dulux, Taubmans and Wattyl, and we spec the system to your job.

mainEntity.name: How do you prep a coastal exterior?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wash down to strip salt and grime, scrape and sand back failed coating, repair and fill, treat any rust or rot, then prime. Prep is most of the job. Skip it near the water and the coat lets go early.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer a workmanship guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: We stand behind our work. We put the exact workmanship guarantee terms in writing on your quote, including the length and what it covers, so it's clear before we start. Ask us to spell it out on the quote.

mainEntity.name: How often should a Palm Beach home be repainted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exposed coastal exteriors usually want attention sooner than inland homes because salt and UV work harder. Sheltered surfaces last longer. We'll tell you honestly what needs doing now and what can wait.

mainEntity.name: Can you paint a heritage cottage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We paint with local heritage controls in mind, including limits on colours and materials for older Palm Beach cottages. Where a heritage impact statement or council approval applies, we work to the approved scheme.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle holiday homes and empty houses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often. We coordinate access for second homes that sit empty part of the year, schedule repaints around your calendar, and send progress photos if you're not on the peninsula while we work.

mainEntity.name: Can you reach high or steep facades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. High-set homes, exposed balconies and big glazed facades are normal out here. We set up the right access and edge protection to paint high and awkward surfaces safely and cleanly.

mainEntity.name: How much does painting cost in Palm Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every job is fixed price with no call-out fee. Cost depends on size, prep, access and whether it's interior, exterior or both. We inspect the property, then quote. No pricing off a photo.

mainEntity.name: How long will the job take?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on scope and access. We'll give you a realistic timeframe with the quote and stick to it. A full exterior on a steep coastal home takes longer than a couple of interior rooms.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint roofs, pools and floors too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Roof restoration and coating, concrete pool painting, and epoxy floor coatings are all in-house. One licensed team for the whole property, not three separate trades to chase.

mainEntity.name: Can you paint a strata or commercial building?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We stage strata and commercial jobs to keep disruption low, work around trading hours or residents, and keep the finish consistent across the whole building.

mainEntity.name: Will you help with colour choice?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can talk through coastal colour schemes that suit your home's aspect, materials and the light on the peninsula. For heritage homes we keep the palette inside any approved colour range.
